summary: The google.cloud.bigquery.reservation.v1beta1.api package is the beta BigQuery Reservation API package superseded by the v1 API; deprecated on 2022-09-27.
extended_definition: The google.cloud.bigquery.reservation.v1beta1.api package is the beta BigQuery Reservation API package superseded by the v1 API; deprecated on 2022-09-27.
